name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-youtube
description: Watch and listen to YouTube in a visible player, keep your own playlists, play the songs of a folder you choose, search by voice, and look after your channel: statistics, comments, replies and uploads you send yourself.

descriptionI18n.en: Watch and listen to YouTube in a visible player, keep your own playlists, play the songs of a folder you choose, search by voice, and look after your channel: statistics, comments, replies and uploads you send yourself.
descriptionI18n.fr: Regarde et écoute YouTube dans un lecteur visible, garde tes propres playlists, joue les chansons d'un dossier que tu choisis, cherche à la voix, et occupe-toi de ta chaîne : statistiques, commentaires, réponses et mises en ligne que tu envoies toi-même.
descriptionI18n.es: Mira y escucha YouTube en un reproductor visible, guarda tus propias listas, reproduce las canciones de una carpeta que elijas, busca por voz y cuida tu canal: estadísticas, comentarios, respuestas y subidas que envías tú.

agentGuide: Name a playlist, a video, a song or a comment the way the person says it (« Jazz du dimanche », « la vidéo de Léa », « le commentaire de Léa »): MnemoPlayer finds it by its words. Several matches are refused with their names (AMBIGUOUS): pick one and call again.

To play: playPlaylist for one of the person's playlists, playItem for a title (or the number of a search result: « le deuxième » is number 2), playMusic for their music folder, play / pause / next / previous / setVolume for what is playing.
To find on YouTube: search (live: true for « un live »). Then playItem with a number or a title, addToPlaylist to keep it.

Their channel: channelStats, comments (says how many are new). A reply and an upload are PREPARED on screen with draftReply and draftUpload, then sent by the person's own click: never say a reply was sent or a video was uploaded.
An upload stays private until Google has reviewed the app.

The equalizer (setEqualizer) shapes the songs of the music folder only: a YouTube video’s sound cannot be filtered from here, and the answer says so. The visualizer (setVisualizer) changes look (bounce is the bouncing bars), turns on or off; no action listens to the computer’s sound.

The exploded view (one window each for the player, up next, the sound, the search and the channel) opens only from a click: the button in MnemoPlayer or the dock’s right-click. There is no action for it; tell the person where to press.

agentActions.summary: What is playing now: title, YouTube or music folder, where it came from, position, volume.
Resume what is loaded in the player, as the ▶ button does.
Pause the player, as the ❚❚ button does.
Play the next item of the current list. At the end of the list the player stops.
Play the previous item of the current list.
Set the volume to a level, or turn it up, down, mute or unmute.
agentActions.details: Give level (0 to 100) OR change. « Monte le son » is change up (one step of 15).

agentActions.summary: Play one of the person's own playlists from its first item.

name.description: The playlist as the person says it (« Jazz du dimanche », « ma playlist sport »).

agentActions.summary: Play a video or a song by the words of its title (in the search on screen, the playlists, the person's videos or the music folder), or a search result by its number.
agentActions.details: number is 1-based on the search results on screen. A YouTube link or video id in title plays that video.

title.description: Words of the title as the person says them, a YouTube link, or a video id.

number.description: The number of a search result on screen (1 = the first).

agentActions.summary: Search public YouTube videos and show the results; only videos that can play here are kept.
agentActions.details: Uses the person's own YouTube key and its daily quota. The answer numbers the results for playItem.

query.description: The words to search (« jazz », « recette de pain »).

live.description: true for live streams only (« un live de jazz »).

agentActions.summary: Create a new, empty playlist with a name.

name.description: The name of the new playlist.

agentActions.summary: Add what is playing (or a video named by its title) to one of the person's playlists.
agentActions.details: The playlist must exist (createPlaylist first). Adding what is already there answers already: true.

playlist.description: The playlist as the person says it.

title.description: Words of the title of what to add; leave out for what is playing now.

agentActions.summary: Show a part of the window: the player, the playlists, the search, the music folder, the channel, the upload form or the settings.
Play the person's music folder from its first song.
agentActions.details: The folder is chosen by the person in the Music tab; without one the refusal says so to the person.

agentActions.summary: The person's YouTube channel: subscribers, views, number of videos.
agentActions.details: A count the person hides is null, never 0.

agentActions.summary: The latest comments on the person's channel, with which are new since they last looked.
Write a reply under a comment of the person's channel, as a DRAFT on screen. It is not sent: the person sends it with a click.

author.description: The author of the comment as the person says it (« Léa »).

video.description: Words of the video's title, when the author commented on several.

agentActions.summary: Fill the title and description of the upload form and show it. Nothing is uploaded: the person picks the file and sends it with a click.
Set the equalizer to a preset (flat, bass, vocal, electronic, jazz, rock, classical, acoustic), as the preset tiles do.
agentActions.details: It shapes the songs of the music folder only; on a YouTube video the answer's say tells the person so. « Mets l'égaliseur en mode jazz » is preset jazz; « plus de basses » is bass; « remets à plat » is flat.

agentActions.summary: Change the visualizer: a look (bounce, bars, radial, wave), the next look, or turn it on or off.
agentActions.details: Give look OR change. « Mets les petites barres » is look bounce (the bouncing bars, the default); « change l'effet du visualiseur » is change next; « coupe le visualiseur » is change off.

look.description: bounce (the little bouncing bars), bars, radial or wave.
